thread:
anna: Quick follow-up from the sidecar unbundle RFC. I put together an evacuation playbook for moving telemetry + lineage features out of the molasses-sidecar into two narrower services (telemetry-ingest, lineage-writer). Goal: reduce blast radius and long tail deploys. cc @sam @diego

sam: Love the split. Key decision: synchronous vs async handoff for lineage events. If we go async we need durable buffering guarantees, otherwise we leak observability.

diego: Buffering at edge is OK but we must avoid unbounded memory growth. Proposal: small in-proc ring buffer + durable append to a local WAL that ships to new service. WAL TTL + checkpointing keeps it bounded. :gear:

nora: Observability owners: we need explicit counters and a per-tenant backpressure metric before we flip traffic. Suggested gates: ingest_success_rate >= 99.5%, backlog_bytes < 50MB, p99_ship_latency < 500ms. Also tie a quality gate for lineage completeness (sample checks).

anna: Phased evacuation plan I sketched:
- Alpha: deploy split services to staging, enable local WAL shipping, no prod traffic
- Beta: shadow writes from sidecar to new services (no read-path change), measure metrics for 72h
- Canary: route 2% real traffic to new services for write-path only, keep read-on-fallback to sidecar
- Ramp: increase write traffic with automated gates, start reconcilers to backfill missed events
- Cutover: flip read-path to consult new lineage service, keep sidecar as fallback for 1 week

sam: Important note on contracts: lineage schema must be backward compatible for 2 months. Add a compatibility shim that maps old fields to new envelope. We should also publish a small JSON schema and a lightweight client lib for downstream teams.

diego: Reconciliation plan: a background worker enumerates sidecar WAL ranges and diff vs new store, reporting per-tenant divergence. Throttle reconcilers to avoid IO spikes. Proposed: 5MB/s sustained per region cap.

anna: Runbook snippets:
```
Gate checks before ramp: ingest_success_rate >= 99.5 AND backlog_bytes < 50MB
If backlog_bytes > 200MB OR ingest_success_rate < 98% for two windows -> PAUSE_RAMP and set feature flag to 0
Pause command: `curl -X POST $FF/toggle?flag=sidecar_unbundle_write&env=prod&value=0`
```

deploy-bot: Shadowing enabled -> env=prod cohort=shadow-72h id=canary-1742001122-1 :satellite:

nora: Ownership + action items: anna (architecture/pm) shepherds rollout appendix, sam (telemetry) owns WAL design and client lib, diego (runtime) owns shipper and reconcilers, nora (obs) owns gates and dashboards. Timeline: alpha this week, shadow next week, canary two weeks out.

sam: Cost note: doubling write volume during shadow/canary will hit egress and storage. Estimate +12% month for the experiment; finance flagged. We'll submit a short budget note.

anna: Thanks. I'll post the appendix and a short checklist in the RFC thread, and schedule a 30m sync Fri to walk owners through the runbook. If nobody objects by tomorrow EOD we'll open alpha. :white_check_mark:
